subject: Client reattempt spiral triggering elevated 5xx/429 — exec escalation
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@montara.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Spike in 5xx/429s and timeouts — Montara production

Hey Vanessa / Sean,

We're seeing a sharp increase in 5xx and 429 responses from Redwood's hosted endpoint for our production tenant since ~07:45 PDT. Throughput dropped ~30% and many requests are timing out at the client. Our SDK telemetry shows a flurry of retries — spikes line up with a deployment on our side at 07:42 that toggled a new HTTP client config.

Attached is a short screenshot of the Grafana panel and a snippet of client logs. Can you confirm if you see corresponding errors on your side? We're on a tight SLA window for a live demo this afternoon.

Thanks,
Liam
Sr. Eng, Montara AI

Attachments: grafana-5xx-spike.png (image), client-snippet.txt (text)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@montara.ai>
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in 5xx/429s and timeouts — Montara production

Thanks for the heads-up, Liam — we see the same 5xx/429 uptick in our edge logs starting 07:46 PDT. Early observations:

- Error mix is ~55% 5xx (upstream runtime) and ~40% 429s; small fraction are timeouts at the load balancer.
- Request pattern looks bursty with repeated identical request IDs from many clients — suggests client-side reattempt amplification.

Immediate actions we're taking:
1) Sean will open an incident ticket and kick off triage.
2) We can apply a temporary per-key soft rate limit and increase circuit-breaker sensitivity for your API key to stabilize tail latency.
3) Please share the exact SDK version and any custom retry/backoff settings — if your new HTTP client removed jitter or increased max attempts we'll probably see synchronized retries.

If this is a client-change-induced reattempt spiral, short-term mitigations on our side plus a rapid rollback or SDK patch from your side should stop the amplification.

I'll escalate to execs for approval on the emergency rate-limit and potential SLA credit if we need an on-air mitigation.

-Vanessa
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Liam O'Connor <liam@montara.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in 5xx/429s and timeouts — Montara production

Quick triage notes:

- I instrumented a short trace window 07:40-08:00 PDT. Root cause appears to be a synchronized pattern of retries with fixed retry intervals (no jitter) from ~1.2k distinct IPs using the same API key. Traffic histograms show 3 sharp peaks ~30s apart.
- Backend pods are healthy but queues are filling, leading to transient 5xx as workers drop slow requests. When clients back off and retry aggressively we see 429s from the rate limiter which then triggers more retries — classic amplification loop.

Proposed immediate mitigations (need account sign-off to apply to prod key):
- Apply a temporary token-scoped soft rate-limit at 75% of baseline to damp bursts.
- Enable accelerated circuit-breaker so slow handlers are tripped earlier.
- Throttle connections from IPs with >50 req/s during the window.

I'll collect logs and a deterministic example payload to help their engineers reproduce. If Montara confirms they pushed a change to retries, that will be the smoking gun.

-Sean
Site Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Liam O'Connor <liam@montara.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in 5xx/429s and timeouts — Montara production

Vanessa / Sean,

Confirmed — we rolled out a change to our HTTP client at 07:40 that inadvertently set retries to 10 and removed jitter for a specific request path (streaming inference calls). We're attaching the small config snippet.

We authorize the temporary soft rate-limit; please apply whatever is needed to stabilize. From our side we'll rollback the client change to the previous retry behaviour and push a patched SDK with exponential backoff + jitter.

We also need to discuss SLA credits — this affected a paid customer demo. I'll loop our CS lead if that's needed.

—Liam

Attachments: Montara-retry-policy.txt (text)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai, Liam O'Connor <liam@montara.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Client reattempt spiral triggering elevated 5xx/429 — request for exec sign-off

Team — looping you in for an executive decision. Summary:

- Impact: Montara production experienced a large, customer-induced retry spiral after a client-side change. Result: sustained elevated 5xx/429 for ~18 minutes, ~30% throughput degradation during the window, and a customer-visible demo interruption.
- Root cause: Montara's change increased retries to 10 and removed jitter, causing synchronized reattempts.
- Actions taken: temporary per-key soft rate-limit applied at 09:10 PDT (token throttling + IP-level throttles), circuit-breaker thresholds tightened, and customer rolled back client change at 09:34 PDT. Services returned to baseline by 09:52 PDT.

Requested approvals:
1) Approve an emergency SLA credit for Montara equivalent to 2x of their hourly committed usage for the affected window.
2) Approve a temporary policy workitem to introduce a short-term SDK safeguard that warns (or blocks) when a customer requests >5 retries without jitter.
3) Approve customer-facing Postmortem + joint action plan call with Montara for tomorrow.

Rationale: This was not a platform defect; however, we want to protect the relationship and avoid repeat incidents by introducing a client-side safeguard and an internal flagging rule for sudden retry parameter changes.

If approved I will coordinate billing and the postmortem.

-Vanessa
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
